description: This file declares the SignalHandler class, which inherits from WebSocketHandler, and manages WebSocket communication for WebRTC signaling, including handling received messages, connection events, and sending server configuration. It references external classes such as DeviceRegistry, ServerConfig, and WebSocketHandler.

classes.name: SignalHandler
classes.description: A class that handles WebSocket signaling for WebRTC, managing message reception, connection events, and communication with device registry and server configuration.

methods.name: OnReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages, with overloads for binary and final message handling.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Pure virtual method to process specific message types received over WebSocket.

methods.name: SendServerConfig
methods.description: Sends the server configuration over WebSocket.

methods.name: LogAndReplyError
methods.description: Logs an error message and sends an error reply.

methods.name: Reply
methods.description: Sends a JSON message as a reply over WebSocket.
